description.message: Sends your downloads to SwiftDL for faster, resumable downloading, and adds a download button to videos.

holdAlt.message: Hold <kbd>Alt</kbd> while clicking to download in the browser

openAppOnce.message: Open the app once. If it's already open, restart the browser.

helperMissing.message: This browser can't find SwiftDL's helper. Install SwiftDL with its installer (not just the .exe file), open it once, then reload this extension.

videoAndAudio.message: Video and audio on this page

noFile.message: No downloadable file found yet. Play the video for a moment, then try again.

extUpdated.message: SwiftDL's extension was updated. Reload this page and try again.

notSetUp.message: SwiftDL isn't set up in this browser yet. Open the SwiftDL app once, then try again.
